alpha_objective: pooled inner Brier; ties within 1e-12 prefer larger alpha
threshold_objective: selected-alpha pooled inner balanced accuracy; ties within 1e-12 prefer closest to 0.5 then larger threshold; one-class labels use 0.5
logistic_objective: sum binary negative log likelihood plus alpha/2 times squared coefficient norm; unpenalized intercept; unweighted
standardization: each training window only; population standard deviation; scale <= 1e-12 becomes 1

solver.roundoff_guard: accept endpoint only if gradient tolerance holds and objective <= current + 8*float64_epsilon*max(1,abs(current))

decision_rule: score strictly greater than selected threshold; equality is nonpositive
primary_metric: Brier improvement versus smoothed training positive frequency
